name: ROM Fix and Final Integration
description: Create a valid GBA ROM file that includes all Phase 117 corrections and can be executed in emulators. This phase focuses on fixing the ROM format issues that prevent the game from loading.
objectives: Create a valid 16MB GBA ROM structure
Include proper GBA header with correct checksum
Embed all Phase 117 data in correct locations
Ensure ROM loads in mGBA and other emulators
Add basic boot code to prevent crashes

hooks.description: Fixes GBA ROM header to be valid
Embeds all Phase 117 data into ROM

new_content.boot_code: Basic GBA boot code to prevent crashes
new_content.data_organization: All Phase 117 data organized in ROM banks

notes: This phase creates a valid GBA ROM file. For a fully functional game, the original Dragon Ball Z: Buu's Fury (USA).gba ROM is required as a base.
